integrity: Exact formulas and infinite proof are self-contained; included reproducible integer and asymptotic spot checker. No independent scientific audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The all-n crossover is proved only for regular Euclidean simplices; it supplies a universal-range upper obstruction but does not solve the unrestricted lower-bound problem. Historical priority is provisional, including incompletely accessible older papers.
title: The regular-simplex obstruction threshold for higher skeletal Vaaler inequalities
